description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Massachusetts General Laws — Massachusetts state statutes — by citation. "M.G.L. c. 265, s. 1" is chapter 265 section 1 (murder). Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Massachusetts General Law chapter 90 section 24 say" or to check a Massachusetts statute a case relies on.

chapter.description: Chapter number, e.g. "265" (crimes against the person) or "90" (motor vehicles).

section.description: Section within the chapter, e.g. "1" or "24".

name: ma_general_law
title: Ma General Law
